subject: Web Development
title: TypeScript: Adding Types to JavaScript
description: A quick win: understand TypeScript: Adding Types to JavaScript.

hook.text: JavaScript lets you add a number to a string without complaining. That flexibility costs bugs.

buildup.text: Microsoft created TypeScript in 2012 — JavaScript with optional type annotations.

discovery.text: TypeScript catches errors at compile time, before your code ever runs in a browser.

twist.text: TypeScript compiles to plain JavaScript. Browsers never see the types at all.

climax.text: By 2024, most new web projects use TypeScript. It became JavaScript's unofficial upgrade.

punchline.text: Types made JavaScript trustworthy at scale.
